decisions.decision: The board is to read and review the van driver policies and the draft guidelines for Eagle House Participation before the next meeting.
decisions.quote: ms. doherty handed out the van driver policies and a draft of guidelines for eagle house participation, which the board is to read and review for the next meeting.

decisions.decision: Ms. Doherty would submit the Eagle House participation guidelines to Town Council for review.
decisions.quote: ms. doherty added that she would also like to submit the guidelines to town council to review.

decisions.decision: Mr. Lincoln volunteered to write a letter, to be read at the next meeting, addressing the small boulders on Memorial Drive.
decisions.quote: mr. lincoln volunteered to write a letter to be read at the next meeting addressing the small boulders on memorial drive.

decisions.decision: The Senior Tax Work-Off committee decided to raise the hourly wage of property tax work-off participants to minimum wage, with the annual maximum earnings unchanged.
decisions.quote: ms. doherty reported the committee has decided to raise the hourly wage of property tax work-off participants to minimum wage; however the maximum amount of money they can earn remains the same at $1,500 per year.
